CYPHER 25
MATCH (difference:QuantityDifference)-[:COMPARED_IN]->(container:ManufacturingContainer)
RETURN difference AS difference, container AS container
LIMIT 100

CYPHER 25
MATCH (difference:QuantityDifference)-[:FOR_VARIANT]->(variant:ProductVariant)
RETURN difference AS difference, variant AS variant
LIMIT 100

CYPHER 25
MATCH (difference:QuantityDifference)-[:COMPARES_PART]->(part:Part)
RETURN difference AS difference, part AS part
LIMIT 100

LIMIT 100
